item.title: Stuff I'm working on - Dev Diary #1
item.description:
Today, I wanted to share with you all a few projects I’m working on.

Bus Driver-inspired paint jobs

I’ve wanted to create paint jobs inspired by Bus Driver, a cult classic created by a much smaller SCS that brought myself and others endless joy and frustration as a child, for the ETS2 Coaches DLC ever since it was first announced. It’s also their first independently published game! Though I’ve made skins before, mainly for Rigs of Rods and OMSI, the new Coaches DLC proved to be quite a challenge, especially with how the UVs are laid out. At least for the Lion’s Coach.

I plan on creating numerous paint jobs for all existing coaches in the DLC. Some coaches may have unique paint jobs. I have yet to finalize exact details.

I call this paint job Laetiporus, after Laetiporus sulphureus, an edible bracket fungus that reportedly tastes like chicken (hence it being commonly called chicken of the woods). I’ll probably change the name of this paint job, though I’m not opposed to chucking in some Latin whenever I can. Due to this paint job’s relative simplicity (just bodyside stripes), I was able to incorporate much of this paint job’s definitions into a single def (.sii) file. I created a separate texture for the front bumper mainly to hide my sloppy texture work prevent bleeding and blank spots, primarily, again, due to how the Lion’s Coach’s UVs were made.

Scania Touring tweaks

I noticed SCS changed quite a few things about the Touring during development, namely the wiper cowl material. It went from painted (mid-2025) to plastic, then to glossy at release. Research showed the Touring could be specced with either. I didn’t like the glossy cowl, so I brought back the plastic cowl as an option since the cowl is already its own accessory! I might adjust the actual wiper materials as well.

Fun fact: the Touring is the only coach in the DLC that required me to stop for fuel mid-route.

Wheels (paid) by Jasper.

item.title: ETS2/ATS Mod Status (1.62)
item.description:
The 1.62 update is now available for American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2.

SCS implemented a new “drivetrain_loss” parameter for the Road Trip cars in this version. I’ve updated Ford Car Pack Powertrain Fixes to incorporate this change. As per their apparent insistence on treating the games like a black box, much to the chagrin of many players and modders, they opted to omit this, among many changes far more interesting than some paintjobs being darker shades of blue and yellow (that you also have to pay for), from the official changelog. You should notice the cars accelerating somewhat more slowly above certain speeds with this version than with 1.61.

ETS2-QJTI has received an update to incorporate some changes SCS made to the DAF XG+. The update will also add the new special XG+ editions to the quick job pool, amend the vanilla oversize FH6 configs to use a more suitable transmission, and fix an issue where the existing FH6 configs would be black.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: ETS2 Mod Status (1.62 Open Beta)
item.description:
ETS2 update 1.62 brought some changes to the DAF XG+ (the top lights are now separate from the cab), meaning ETS2-QJTI needs to be updated. The compatibility changes have been made and will be released after the beta is over.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: ETS2/ATS Mod Status (1.61)
item.description:
The 1.61 update is now available for American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2.

It appears that all currently supported mods for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator work without issues with the new update.

I plan on releasing a collection of small mods for both games that take advantage of some of the new features that 1.61 brings, mainly in preparation for the Road Trip expansion for ATS.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: ETS2/ATS Mod Status (1.60)
item.description:
Just over a month after the release of 1.59, 1.60 is available for American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2.

  • None of the vanilla S-Way Quick Jobs configs use metallic colors anymore, but they still don’t have retarders, so the overrides in ETS2-QJTI will stick.
  • Extra VNL Parts was updated to fix an issue where the newly added mirror text was just nonsense.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: ETS2/ATS Mod Status (1.59)
item.description:
Mods that rely on SCS localization string keys may have display issues in the games’ user interface with the 1.59 update. This affects some of my ETS2 mods.

It appears that all of my currently supported mods for American Truck Simulator work without issues with the 1.59 update.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: ETS2/ATS Mod Status (1.58)
item.description:
Since ATS 1.58 came out yesterday and ETS2 1.58 is apparently coming out tomorrow, figured I’d write this.

ETS2-QJTI release 26.01 has some issues with the 1.58 update. This is due to SCS changing some things around with the Scania R & S with this update. Older releases, however, should work fine. SCS already fixed the issue that version intended to fix, so that override will be removed with the next update anyway.

I will also need to verify if FH6 Headlight Guard Fix needs tweaking. UPDATE FEB 12, 2026: This mod is now obsolete with 1.58.

It appears that all other currently supported mods for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator work without issues with the 1.58 update.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: TruckyMods update
item.description:
Due to a Cloudflare outage, my mods hosted on TruckyMods will be unavailable for the time being.

Note to self: don’t put all your eggs in one basket.

item.title: ETS2 Mod Status (1.57 Open Beta)
item.description:
I’m not sure if any mods need updating at the moment – probably not. At the time I’m writing this, I’m currently downloading the open beta for ETS2 1.57.

Depending on how this update affects the Scania R and S Quick Job trucks, which were updated with this version, ETS2-QJTI may receive an update related to them. ETS2-QJTI never affected these trucks, so the current version should still work with 1.57.

You can see all mods here.

item.title: ETS2/ATS Mod Status (1.56)
item.description:
Long overdue, but it appears that all currently supported mods for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator work without issues with the 1.56 update.

An undocumented change with 1.56 was that FMOD was updated from version 2.02.25 to 2.03.09. A select few sound mods may be impacted by this change. I haven’t produced any, but others have, so check with them to see if they need updating.

You can see all mods here.
